questions.question_text_en: In angiosperms, the male gametophyte is represented by the:
questions.explanation_en: The pollen grain is the male gametophyte in angiosperms; it germinates on the stigma and forms the pollen tube.
questions.subject: Botany

questions.question_text_en: The loss of water vapour from the aerial parts of a plant, mainly through the stomata, is called:
questions.explanation_en: Transpiration is the evaporative loss of water from the aerial parts of the plant, mostly through stomata.
questions.subject: Botany

questions.question_text_en: In mammals, fertilisation normally takes place in the:
questions.explanation_en: Fertilisation in mammals occurs in the ampulla region of the oviduct (fallopian tube).
questions.subject: Zoology
